versions.changelog:
Initial release of dingtalk-ai-web-search.

- Enables real-time web search and information retrieval via DingTalk.
- Supports keyword search, time range filtering (day/week/month/year), custom result counts, and JSON output.
- Provides guidance for MCP configuration and connectivity checks at session start.
- Includes troubleshooting steps if configuration or connectivity issues occur.
- Offers quick reference commands for common usage scenarios and workflow examples.
